title: Open source Kanban desktop app that runs parallel agents on every card
summary: KanBots is an open-source Kanban desktop application that leverages AI agents to automate and enhance task management. Each card in the Kanban board can run parallel AI agents to handle various sub-tasks, enabling intelligent automation of workflow processes.
problem_solved: Automates repetitive task management workflows by running AI agents on each Kanban card to handle sub-tasks in parallel.
why_valuable: Combines visual project management with AI automation, allowing users to delegate complex multi-step workflows to intelligent agents while maintaining a familiar Kanban interface.
